text:
alex: quick note: ochre-13b int6 bring-up finished smoke + evals. want a concise cost-vs-quality playbook for GTN/product before any rollout
jiayi: drop the headline numbers?
alex: int6 vs int8 baseline on 4k batching: p50 48ms -> 52ms (+4ms), p95 190ms -> 235ms (+45ms). throughput down ~5%. est unit cost int6 $0.0032 /1k toks vs int8 $0.0065 /1k toks (~51% savings)
rene: big cost win. what about quality?
alex: ran 3k GTN sample slices: average exact-match/accuracy delta ~ -0.6% absolute overall, but certain slices worse: multi-step instructions -1.9%, long-context summarization -1.4%, entity-extraction (rare tokens) -1.2%. hallucination +0.9% on legal-extracts
mike: those slices map to product-critical flows (legal/billing/search snippets). We need routing rules before sending live traffic.

deploy-bot: candidate ochre-13b-int6 smoke -> status: cost_down, latency_tail_up, error_rate nominal
jiayi: propose three-layer routing: 1) explicit high-assurance tag -> int8 2) code/legal/financial detector -> int8 3) else int6. Also add context-length cutoff: context_len > 1100 -> int8.
rene: for detector, start with regex/keyword heuristics + small classifier later. keep threshold conservative (prob_high_assurance > 0.7 -> int8).
alex: operational constraints: limit max_tokens to 1024 on int6 for now (kv stability). also clip streaming chunk size to reduce tail variance.
mike: we need a one-page scorecard for PMs. Suggested columns: slice_name, sample_n, metric (acc/EM/ROUGE/F1/hallu), int8_value, int6_value, delta_abs, pct_delta, acceptable_limit, routing_recommendation, biz_impact_note
jiayi: I'll assemble a CSV. add an extra sheet with 10 worst examples (redacted) and suggested messaging for GTN.
rene: monitoring rules: alert if hallucination_delta > +1.2% OR p95 increase > +15% OR fallback_rate > 1% in 30m. Auto-fallback to int8 on any hallucination signal + rollback playbook.
alex: rollout plan: 1) shadow 75% of traffic to int6 for 72h 2) if no alerts, start 10% live non-high-assurance short-context flows 3) monitor 7 days, expand to 40% if stable.
mike: product wording draft: "Cost tier: 50% lower inference cost for everyday content. Fidelity tier: designed for legal, finance, code, and long-context tasks." keep both on same API; routing transparent.
jiayi: also include price bucket guidance w/ expected $/M tokens and sample savings calc for medium/high volume customers.
rene: note on quant artifacts: token-perplexity slope increases after 900 tokens on int6 for some documents; long-context distill may need re-tuning. record as technical debt for model team.
alex: dataset note: we saw hallucination pattern in clause extraction when numeric tokens mixed with roman numerals. attaching sample diffs: https://gist.github.com/redwood/ochre13b-int6-examples (redacted)
mike: ops todo: create flag ochre-int6-canary, deploy routing hook, add dashboards (per-slice quality, latency by model variant & context_len, fallback-rate), enable sample capture to S3 for manual review
jiayi: timeline: CSV + one-pager by EOD tomorrow; ops implement flags + dashboards this week; start shadowing Fri; start 10% live Mon next week if green. check-in 7 days after live.
alex: thanks all. once CSV posted, PMs/GTN please sign-off on acceptable limits for each slice. :thumbsup:
